templates.headline: How much is your home worth?
templates.primary_text: Thinking of selling in {{suburb}}? Get a free, no-pressure price update from a local agent who knows the street, not just the suburb. Find out what your home could be worth in today's market.
templates.winner_rationale: 'How Much is Your Home Worth?' (Investors Edge) ran 419 days; the highest-frequency hook in the DB ('home worth', 'how much is YOUR HOME worth'). Cross-agency proven.

templates.headline: Get your FREE {{suburb}} price update
templates.primary_text: Hey {{suburb}} homeowners - how much is your home worth in this current market? Get a free, instant price update. No obligation, no door-knocking, just a clear local number.
templates.winner_rationale: Peard Real Estate 'Get your FREE price update now / Hey {Suburb} Homeowners' run identically across Kingsley, North Beach etc. - reusable suburb-swap winner.

templates.headline: You might be surprised
templates.primary_text: Most {{suburb}} owners are surprised when they hear what their home is worth right now. Curious? Get a free price update and find out where you stand - no pressure to sell.
templates.description: See what your {{suburb}} home could fetch
templates.winner_rationale: Hook 'SURPRISED to hear how much your home is worth' appears 19x across advertisers - a proven curiosity opener.

templates.headline: Your {{suburb}} value in 5 seconds
templates.primary_text: Want to know what your property is worth? Get a FREE instant price estimate for your {{suburb}} home. Whether you're selling, buying or just curious, it takes seconds.
templates.winner_rationale: Xceed 'Receive Your Free Property Price Estimator Instantly!' + Neon '[FREE] Property Report - Takes You 5 Seconds' - low-friction instant-estimate hook recurs across agencies.

templates.headline: How much are you leaving behind?
templates.primary_text: {{suburb}}, how much are you leaving on the table? Right now homes here are selling for more than most owners expect, and buyers are still active. Get your free property report.
templates.winner_rationale: Neon Property Group '[FREE] Property Report / How Much Are You Leaving on the Table?' (77d, active) - loss-aversion framing.

templates.headline: Free appraisal with {{agent_name}}
templates.primary_text: Free appraisals in {{suburb}} - want to know what your home is worth? The market is strong and it's a great time to understand your options. Book a no-pressure appraisal with {{agent_name}}.
templates.winner_rationale: 'FREE APPRAISAL WITH ALYSSA' (95d, 7 versions) - personalising the appraisal to a named agent lifts brandFit + local trust.

templates.headline: [FREE] {{suburb}} market report
templates.primary_text: {{suburb}} market update: prices moved {{growth_12m}} over the past year. Our latest quarterly report breaks down median values, buyer demand and where the market is heading. Grab your free digital copy.
templates.winner_rationale: Vivian's '[FREE] Digital Copy of our Mosman Park Report / Prices skyrocket 23%' - 778-856 days active, 7 versions. Top winner in the DB; market_update has the highest avg longevity (139d).

templates.headline: {{suburb}} property market update
templates.primary_text: The {{suburb}} market is moving, and now is a good time to take stock. Our latest update shares key insights on buyer demand, listing numbers and recent results. Straightforward, local and relevant to you.
templates.winner_rationale: 'Berwick Property Market Update' / 'Local Market Report - Beaconsfield Upper' (240-251d, active) - JR Property suburb-report series.

templates.headline: See the latest trends in your area
templates.primary_text: Buyer demand remains strong across {{suburb}}, with well-presented homes selling quickly. Download your free Market Update to see the full picture - prices, demand and what it means if you're thinking of selling.
templates.winner_rationale: 'See the Latest Trends in Your Area' ran 282 days (active, carousel) - soft-intent TOFU opener that feeds the report offer.

templates.headline: {{suburb}} median: {{median_value}}
templates.primary_text: Updated median value for {{suburb}}: {{median_value}} ({{growth_12m}} year-on-year). Discover the latest on the local market in our newest quarterly report - investment, demand and price trends in one place.
templates.winner_rationale: Vivian's 'UPDATED MEDIAN VALUE Mosman Park $2.19M / Prices Surge 23%' image variant (778d). Stat-card format travels across suburbs.

templates.headline: Are buyers competing for homes like yours?
templates.primary_text: Property values across {{suburb}} have shifted - but not every street is moving the same way. If you've been thinking about selling, the buyer pool right now might surprise you. See where your home sits.
templates.description: See current demand for your home type
templates.winner_rationale: 'Are Buyers Still Competing For Homes Like Yours?' (carousel, active) - demand-led seller prompt without over-claiming.

templates.headline: Curious what your home is worth?
templates.primary_text: {{suburb}} property update: {{growth_12m}} growth over the past 12 months, {{growth_5y}} over 5 years, and {{active_buyers}} active buyers right now. Want to know what yours could be worth? Get your free update.
templates.winner_rationale: Renouf Real Estate 'Curious what your home is worth? / {Suburb} PROPERTY UPDATE: X% / Y% / N Active Buyers' - same structure run across Alexandra Hills, Ormiston, Wellington Point. Highly reusable.

templates.headline: Strong demand. Low stock.
templates.primary_text: The {{suburb}} market is strong, buyer demand is high and quality stock is low - which is exactly when well-prepared sellers do best. Thinking about it? Start with a free price update.
templates.winner_rationale: 'The market is strong, buyer demand is high, and it's a great time to sell' recurs in long-running appraisal ads (e.g. Free Appraisal with Alyssa, 95d).

templates.headline: Just sold - yours could be next
templates.primary_text: More {{suburb}} homes successfully sold! See how our strategy delivers strong results for local sellers. Swipe to view our recent sales - then find out what it could mean for your home.
templates.winner_rationale: Ray White Dethridge Groves 'Just Sold - yours could be next' (carousel, 13 creative versions - heavily iterated = backed by spend).

templates.headline: Another one sold in {{suburb}}
templates.primary_text: Another sold - {{address}}! We loved selling this one. After getting it presentation-ready and running the right marketing campaign, we achieved a great result for the owners. Thinking of selling? Let's talk.
templates.winner_rationale: Vivian's 'ANOTHER SOLD - 3 Houston Place, Mount Claremont' (194d, video) - behind-the-result storytelling builds vendor trust.

templates.headline: Sold under the hammer
templates.primary_text: SOLD via auction - {{address}}. With {{bidders}} registered bidders and a result the sellers are thrilled with. Want this kind of competition for your home? Let's talk strategy.
templates.winner_rationale: Neon Property Group 'SOLD VIA AUCTION 7 Namoi Court - 8 registered bidders, $1,410,000' - concrete proof with real figures.

templates.headline: What sold near you in {{suburb}}?
templates.primary_text: Curious what's been selling near you? Get a free recent-sales report for {{suburb}} - real comparable results that show where your home could sit in today's market.
templates.winner_rationale: recent_sales_report is a core AdStudio offer; 'just sold' proof ads (avg 37d) convert best when tied to a comparables download.

templates.headline: Just listed in {{suburb}}
templates.winner_rationale: 'Just Listed | 2/19 Waratah Avenue / 3 Bed 2 Bath 1 Car' (Renouf) + 'Just Listed' among top hooks (23x). Spec-bar layout is the category default.

templates.headline: First time offered: {{address}}
templates.primary_text: {{address}} - first time offered! {{beds}} bed {{baths}} bath on {{land}}. Light, bright and perfectly positioned. Offers from {{price}}. Be quick - homes like this don't last in {{suburb}}.
templates.winner_rationale: '5 Dandy Place Bayswater / First Time Offered - Light, Bright' (39d, video). 'First time offered' adds scarcity to a standard listing.

templates.headline: Selling fast - register now
templates.primary_text: Coming soon to {{suburb}}: {{project_or_address}}. Connected living, smart buying, boutique opportunity. Register your interest now to get first access before the public launch.
templates.winner_rationale: 'Selling fast! Register your interest now / boutique opportunity' (The Crossings at Wellard, active) - pre-launch list-building.

templates.headline: {{project_name}} now selling
templates.primary_text: {{project_name}} - exceed every expectation. 1, 2 & 3 bedroom residences at {{address}}. Residences from {{price}}*. A boutique opportunity in one of {{suburb}}'s best-connected pockets.
templates.winner_rationale: 'Horizon Hurstville / 1, 2 & 3 Bedroom Residences / From $668k*' (carousel, multiple long-running versions). '1,2 & 3 Bedroom Residences' is a top recurring hook (26x).

templates.headline: Secure your home with {{deposit_pct}} deposit
templates.primary_text: Your new {{suburb}} home is closer than you think. Secure a brand-new residence at {{project_name}} with only {{deposit_pct}} deposit*. Modern design, great location, limited release.
templates.winner_rationale: 'Secure your new home with only 5% deposit' is a top recurring hook (22x) across off-the-plan campaigns - the deposit angle drives first-home-buyer leads.

templates.headline: Land now selling at {{project_name}}
templates.primary_text: The future is... living minutes from {{landmark}}. A variety of land now selling at {{project_name}}, {{suburb}}. There's no better time to find a lot that suits your lifestyle.
templates.winner_rationale: 'Variety Of Land Now Selling / Living minutes from Whiteman Park Train Station' (223d) + 'Land Now Selling / Brabham Estate' (249d). Lifestyle + transport proximity sells lots.

templates.headline: Open this Saturday: {{address}}
templates.primary_text: Open for inspection this {{day}} at {{time}} - {{address}}, {{suburb}}. {{beds}} bed {{baths}} bath. Come and see it in person. Can't make it? Message us for a private viewing.
templates.winner_rationale: open_home is a core AdStudio template; open-home ads are short-lived by nature (avg 13-18d) but high-intent BOFU. Exact date/time/address drives attendance.

templates.headline: Display suite now open
templates.primary_text: Now's your chance to step inside {{project_name}}. Visit our on-site display suite in {{suburb}} and explore {{beds}}-bed residences from {{price}}*. Under construction - secure early.
templates.winner_rationale: 'Visit the on-site Display Suite' / 'On-site Display Suite' recurs (15x) in long-running development campaigns (e.g. Burswood Point).

templates.headline: 5 reasons to sell at auction
templates.primary_text: 5 reasons to sell at auction: it's done on the day, no conditions, it creates competition, you set the settlement terms, and the price is driven by real demand. Want to maximise your result? Let's chat.
templates.description: Is auction right for your home?
templates.winner_rationale: Neon Property Group runs a whole educational auction series ('5 Reasons to Sell at Auction', 'Auction day can move quickly...') - consistent, low-cost authority content.

templates.headline: Auction {{date}}: {{address}}
templates.primary_text: {{address}} goes to auction {{date}} at {{time}}. {{property_desc}}. Register to bid or come feel the energy of auction day. Talk to {{agent_name}} for the contract and inspection times.
